title: Hubs
description: What a hub is: digital artifacts, private by default, public and listed on Explore when ready, collaborators, settings areas, SEO, and plan limits.
content:
A hub is a curated place for digital artifacts and collaborators—private by default, public and listed when you’re ready. Monetization is optional.

Primary action: Open the app → create a hub

What’s inside a hub

Hubs hold digital artifacts such as:

  • Files, videos, images, PDFs, documents
  • Links and notes
  • And more as the product supports

Lifecycle: private → public → Explore

  1. Create — A new hub starts private. Add artifacts and shape it before anyone else can see it.
  2. Collaborate — Invite people with roles when you want help. Work stays private until you change access.
  3. Make public — Share a link when you are ready. Public does not mean listed on Explore yet.
  4. List on Explore — Optionally list so people can find the hub in the public catalog and in search.
  5. Optional paid access — Turn on monetization later if you want. Free knowledge hubs stay first-class.

Listing checklist: List a hub on Explore. Creators path: Get started (creators).

Collaborators and roles

RoleWhat it means
OWNERFull control of the hub, including ownership decisions.
ADMINManage settings and collaborators without transferring ownership.
WRITEAdd and edit artifacts alongside the team.
COMMENTLeave feedback without changing the contents.
READView access for people who only need to look.

Collaborators are not the same as paywall buyers. How-to: Collaborators & roles.

Hub settings areas

In the app, hub settings typically group into:

  • General
  • Access
  • Monetization
  • Storefront
  • Analytics

Analytics for creators: Analytics for creators. Paid access: Turn on paid access.

SEO and listing

  • Explore-listed public non-adult hubs get bot HTML and sitemap inclusion.
  • Public-but-unlisted hubs stay shareable by link, but stay noindex.

Marketplace signals

  • Marketplace cards can show views, saves, and Aura.
  • Creators get analytics in hub settings to see how the hub is doing.

Plan limits (high level)

Exact numbers can change—confirm on Pricing and in-app Billing.

*Confirm current Free upload rules in product. When to upgrade: Plans: when to upgrade.

  • Profiles — your public presence.
